name: RC-B10-0260/2026 – After § 1 – Am 9
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the repression and execution of protesters, dissidents, political prisoners and religious minorities in Iran
part_text: 1a. Defends the right of the Iranian people to decide their own political future without coercion or foreign interference, and reaffirms its support for the independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity of Iran as a member state of the United Nations;
